info.title: aidesk API
info.description: REST API of aidesk. Every route is generated from one route table; the access of a route names the action that has to be granted for the project concerned.

get.summary: List the projects the caller may read

post.summary: Create a project

get.summary: List operators with their sign-in methods and the grants the caller manages

post.summary: Create an operator

get.summary: List the agent tokens of a project (never the token itself)

post.summary: Issue an agent token; it is shown once

get.summary: List the saved versions of the mail design and which one is active

post.summary: Save a new version of the mail design

get.summary: The editable configuration of a project and the version to name when writing

put.summary: Replace the configuration. Applies at once (200) or, for an agent under the review policy, becomes a proposal (202). With validate=true nothing is written and the outcome is only reported

parameters.name: validate
parameters.description: Report the diff and the outcome without writing

get.summary: Applied and proposed configuration changes, newest first

target.description: The connection a connection change concerns

post.summary: Activate or reject a proposed change; only a person with config.approve

get.summary: The connections of a project; secrets are never returned

secretSet.description: Whether a secret is stored; the secret itself is never returned

post.summary: Define a connection. Applies at once (201) or becomes a proposal (202) for an agent under the review policy; with validate=true nothing is written (200). A new connection is a draft until a test succeeds

parameters.name: validate
parameters.description: Report the diff and the outcome without writing

put.summary: Change a connection: name, configuration and secret replace the stored values when present. The connection becomes a draft and has to pass a test again

parameters.name: validate
parameters.description: Report the diff and the outcome without writing

post.summary: Disable a connection so that nothing is read or sent through it

parameters.name: validate
parameters.description: Report the diff and the outcome without writing

post.summary: Check that the connection can be used (login, mailbox or bucket, token) and record ready or degraded with a code. Sends and reads no mail

get.summary: The texts a project can set (acknowledgement, the line before the ticket link, the customer page), with the built-in wording, the project's own and the version

own.description: The project's own wording, if it set one

version.description: The version to name when changing it; 0 if never set

own.description: The project's own wording, if it set one

version.description: The version to name when changing it; 0 if never set

get.summary: Every version of one text in one language, newest first

text.description: null: back to the built-in wording

put.summary: Set the project's wording of a text in en or de, or return it to the built-in wording with null. Applies at once (200) or, for an agent under the review policy, becomes a proposal (202). Every change is a new version

parameters.name: validate
parameters.description: Report the diff and the outcome without writing

bearer.description: An agent token issued for a project.

session.name: better-auth.session_token
session.description: The operator session. Requests that change data must carry the application's own Origin header.

Problem400.description: The request body or a parameter is not valid

Problem401.description: Not signed in or token not valid

Problem403.description: The caller may not do this

Problem404.description: Not found, or not visible to the caller

Problem409.description: The state does not allow this

error.description: A stable code such as invalid_input, forbidden or stale_version

pointer.description: JSON pointer to the offending field of the request
